description: Retrieve the unlocked routed .kicad_pcb layout and turnkey manufacturing .zip bundle (Gerber X2, Excellon drill files, IPC-D-356A netlist, BOM/CPL pick-and-place tables, and 3D DC IR-drop qualification report) for a paid job_id. Call this final workflow step after payment is confirmed via Stripe, calligraphy_verify_crypto_payment, or calligraphy_verify_stablecoin_payment. Requires job_id; set include_bundle_b64=True to inline Base64 .zip bytes or pass output_dir in local STDIO mode. Returns JSON with status, unlocked, download_zip_url, routed_kicad_pcb_text, and deletion_receipt_sha256; if PermissionError occurs, complete payment unlock first.

include_bundle_b64.description: When true, embeds the complete turnkey .zip archive as Base64 in bundle_zip_b64 and triggers immediate zero-retention vault auto-purge.

job_id.description: Unlocked compilation job identifier to download. Example: 'job_01'.

output_dir.description: Optional local filesystem directory where routed.kicad_pcb and bundle.zip will be written (local STDIO mode only). Example: './fab_out'.

name: calligraphy_download_fab_bundle
title: Download Unlocked Turnkey Fabrication Bundle
